package com.synexia.mindex.compiler.ast;

import com.synexia.mindex.MIndexProgressMonitor;
import com.synexia.mindex.ast.MIndexAST;
import com.synexia.mindex.ast.MIndexASTLimits;
import com.synexia.mindex.ast.MIndexASTSnapshot;
import com.synexia.mindex.ast.partial.MIndexPartialAstAttempt;
import com.synexia.mindex.ast.partial.MIndexPartialAstKey;
import com.synexia.mindex.ast.partial.MIndexPartialAstMaster;
import com.synexia.mindex.ast.partial.MIndexPartialAstMode;
import com.synexia.mindex.ast.partial.MIndexPartialAstProjection;
import com.synexia.mindex.ast.partial.MIndexPartialAstScope;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.TreeMap;
import java.util.TreeSet;
import java.util.function.Supplier;

/**
 * Leaf-first facts over the canonical scoped AST and partial-AST master.
 *
 * <p>L0 is per-file facts and atoms; L1 file summary; L2 package; L3 module;
 * L4 project; L5 repository. These are containment levels, not parser scopes or JDK phases.
 * Publication only seals bounded topology and immutable inputs. The first acquisition resolves
 * children before parents; subsequent consumers and cold reloads share the existing swap owner.
 * No parser, AST arena, payload store, LRU, source mutation or promotion authority is introduced.</p>
 *
 * <p>The context is a separately sealed hierarchy configuration, not a reusable live compiler
 * generation. Every input retains its complete actual source/compiler/provider/phase key.
 * Declared source dependencies are transitive, cycle-safe and exact. External dependencies and
 * options must be covered by the supplied compiler context pins. Unchanged branches retain their
 * ordinals only when all their admitted identities remain exact. Old plans are immutable views;
 * the caller owns their lifetime and any frozen-document suppliers they retain.</p>
 */
public final class MIndexASTHierarchy implements AutoCloseable {
    public enum Level {
        L0_FILE_FACTS, L1_FILE, L2_PACKAGE, L3_MODULE, L4_PROJECT, L5_REPOSITORY
    }

    /** Qualified containment address. Empty package means the Java default package. */
    public record Address(Level level, String repository, String project, String module,
            String packageName, String sourceUri) {
        public Address {
            Objects.requireNonNull(level, "level");
            token(repository, false); token(project, level.ordinal() >= 5);
            token(module, level.ordinal() >= 4); token(packageName, true); token(sourceUri, true);
            if (level.ordinal() >= 5 && !project.isEmpty()
                    || level.ordinal() >= 4 && !module.isEmpty()
                    || level.ordinal() >= 3 && !packageName.isEmpty()
                    || level.ordinal() >= 2 && !sourceUri.isEmpty()
                    || level.ordinal() <= 1 && sourceUri.isEmpty())
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("hierarchy address geometry");
        }
        public Address parent() {
            return switch (level) {
                case L0_FILE_FACTS -> new Address(Level.L1_FILE, repository, project, module, packageName, sourceUri);
                case L1_FILE -> new Address(Level.L2_PACKAGE, repository, project, module, packageName, "");
                case L2_PACKAGE -> new Address(Level.L3_MODULE, repository, project, module, "", "");
                case L3_MODULE -> new Address(Level.L4_PROJECT, repository, project, "", "", "");
                case L4_PROJECT -> new Address(Level.L5_REPOSITORY, repository, "", "", "", "");
                case L5_REPOSITORY -> throw new IllegalStateException("repository has no parent");
            };
        }
        private List<String> identityParts() {
            return List.of(level.name(), repository, project, module, packageName, sourceUri);
        }
    }

    /** Explicit bounds on retained topology and preparation work, separate from payload budgets. */
    public record Limits(int maxFiles, int maxNodes, int maxDependencyEdges,
            long maxDependencySteps, int maxValues, int maxNameChars, MIndexASTLimits ast) {
        public Limits {
            Objects.requireNonNull(ast, "ast");
            if (maxFiles < 1 || maxFiles > 1_000_000 || maxNodes < 6 || maxNodes > 6_000_000
                    || maxDependencyEdges < 0 || maxDependencySteps < 1 || maxValues < 1
                    || maxValues > 256 || maxNameChars < 1 || maxNameChars > 16_384)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("hierarchy limits");
        }
        public static Limits defaults() {
            return new Limits(10_000, 60_000, 100_000, 2_000_000, 256, 4096, MIndexASTLimits.defaults());
        }
    }

    /**
     * Frozen source boundary. The supplier must return an existing immutable document, never parse
     * or retain a live compiler tree. It runs only on a partial-AST miss and is validated before use.
     * Within one plan source URIs are unique; cross-project instances require separate owners.
     */
    public static final class FileInput {
        private final String project, module, packageName;
        private final M3FileSourceFacts source;
        private final List<String> dependencies;
        private final Supplier<MIndexASTDocument> document;

        private FileInput(String project, String module, String packageName, M3FileSourceFacts source,
                Collection<String> dependencies, Supplier<MIndexASTDocument> document) {
            this.project = token(project, false);
            this.module = token(module, false);
            this.packageName = token(packageName, true);
            this.source = Objects.requireNonNull(source, "source");
            TreeSet<String> sorted = new TreeSet<>();
            for (String dependency : Objects.requireNonNull(dependencies, "dependencies")) {
                if (!sorted.add(token(dependency, false))) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duplicate source dependency");
            }
            this.dependencies = List.copyOf(sorted);
            this.document = Objects.requireNonNull(document, "document");
        }
        public String project() { return project; }
        public String module() { return module; }
        public String packageName() { return packageName; }
        public M3FileSourceFacts source() { return source; }
        public List<String> dependencies() { return dependencies; }
        public Address address(String repository) {
            return new Address(Level.L0_FILE_FACTS, repository, project, module, packageName, source.sourceUri());
        }
    }

    public static FileInput fromMIndex(String project, String module, String packageName,
            M3FileSourceFacts source, Collection<String> dependencies, Supplier<MIndexASTDocument> document) {
        return new FileInput(project, module, packageName, source, dependencies, document);
    }

    public static FileInput fromM3(String project, String module, String packageName,
            M3FileSourceFacts source, Collection<String> dependencies, Supplier<M3AST> document) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(document, "document");
        return fromMIndex(project, module, packageName, source, dependencies,
                () -> Objects.requireNonNull(document.get(), "M3 AST").asMIndex());
    }

    /** Synchronous, isolated provider. Its identity and ordered field schema must remain immutable. */
    public interface Provider {
        String id();
        int schemaVersion();
        List<String> fields();
        long[] file(FileInput input, MIndexPartialAstProjection projection, MIndexProgressMonitor monitor);
        long[] aggregate(Level level, List<MIndexASTHierarchyFacts> children, MIndexProgressMonitor monitor);
    }

    /** Actual AST/source measures; per-file distinct atom counts are additive, not global deduplication. */
    public static Provider counts() {
        return new Provider() {
            @Override public String id() { return "mindex-ast-hierarchy-counts"; }
            @Override public int schemaVersion() { return 1; }
            @Override public List<String> fields() {
                return List.of("files", "sourceUtf16Units", "expandedNodes", "perFileDistinctAtoms", "maxDepth");
            }
            @Override public long[] file(FileInput input, MIndexPartialAstProjection projection,
                    MIndexProgressMonitor monitor) {
                monitor.checkCancelled();
                MIndexAST root = projection.root();
                return new long[] {1, input.source.utf16Length(), root.expandedSize(), root.reachableAtoms(), root.depth()};
            }
            @Override public long[] aggregate(Level level, List<MIndexASTHierarchyFacts> children,
                    MIndexProgressMonitor monitor) {
                long[] values = new long[5];
                for (MIndexASTHierarchyFacts child : children) {
                    monitor.checkCancelled();
                    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) values[i] = Math.addExact(values[i], child.value(i));
                    values[4] = Math.max(values[4], child.value(4));
                }
                return values;
            }
        };
    }

    private static final Comparator<Address> ORDER = Comparator.comparing(Address::level)
            .thenComparing(Address::repository).thenComparing(Address::project).thenComparing(Address::module)
            .thenComparing(Address::packageName).thenComparing(Address::sourceUri);
    private final String contextSha256, providerId, providerSeal;
    private final int schemaVersion;
    private final List<String> fields;
    private final Provider provider;
    private final MIndexPartialAstMaster leaves;
    private final M3ASTWorkspaceCache<MIndexASTHierarchyFacts> cache;
    private final Limits limits;
    private final boolean ownsCache;
    private long nextId;
    private Plan current;
    private boolean closed;

    public MIndexASTHierarchy(String contextSha256, Provider provider, MIndexPartialAstMaster leaves,
            M3ASTWorkspaceCache<MIndexASTHierarchyFacts> cache, Limits limits, boolean ownsCache) {
        this.contextSha256 = M3FileSourceFacts.requireSha256(contextSha256, "hierarchy context");
        this.provider = Objects.requireNonNull(provider, "provider");
        this.leaves = Objects.requireNonNull(leaves, "leaves");
        this.cache = Objects.requireNonNull(cache, "cache");
        this.limits = Objects.requireNonNull(limits, "limits");
        if (!contextSha256.equals(cache.contextSha256())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("foreign hierarchy cache context");
        providerId = token(provider.id(), false);
        schemaVersion = provider.schemaVersion();
        fields = List.copyOf(provider.fields());
        if (providerId.length() > 1024 || schemaVersion < 1 || fields.isEmpty()
                || fields.size() > limits.maxValues || new HashSet<>(fields).size() != fields.size())
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("hierarchy provider schema");
        for (String field : fields) requireName(token(field, false));
        List<String> identity = new ArrayList<>(List.of("MINDEX_HIERARCHY_PROVIDER_V1", contextSha256,
                providerId, Integer.toString(schemaVersion), Integer.toString(fields.size())));
        identity.addAll(fields);
        providerSeal = M3FileSourceFacts.contextSha256(identity);
        this.ownsCache = ownsCache;
    }

    public List<String> fields() { return fields; }

    /** Seal one new immutable source generation without reading a document or invoking a provider. */
    public synchronized Plan publish(String repository, Collection<FileInput> inputs) {
        requireOpen(); requireProvider(); requireName(token(repository, false));
        Objects.requireNonNull(inputs, "inputs");
        if (inputs.isEmpty() || inputs.size() > limits.maxFiles) throw new IllegalArgumentException("hierarchy file budget");
        TreeMap<String, FileInput> byUri = new TreeMap<>();
        for (FileInput input : inputs) {
            Objects.requireNonNull(input, "input");
            requireName(input.project); requireName(input.module); requireName(input.packageName);
            requireName(input.source.sourceUri());
            if (input.source.utf16Length() > limits.ast.sourceChars()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("source character budget");
            if (byUri.putIfAbsent(input.source.sourceUri(), input) != null)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("duplicate source URI");
        }
        FileInput[] files = byUri.values().toArray(FileInput[]::new);
        Map<String, Integer> fileOrdinals = new HashMap<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < files.length; i++) fileOrdinals.put(files[i].source.sourceUri(), i);
        int[][] dependencies = new int[files.length][];
        String[] base = new String[files.length];
        long dependencyEdges = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
            FileInput file = files[i];
            dependencyEdges = Math.addExact(dependencyEdges, file.dependencies.size());
            if (dependencyEdges > limits.maxDependencyEdges) throw new IllegalArgumentException("source dependency edge budget");
            dependencies[i] = new int[file.dependencies.size()];
            for (int j = 0; j < dependencies[i].length; j++) {
                String uri = file.dependencies.get(j);
                requireName(uri);
                Integer dependency = fileOrdinals.get(uri);
                if (dependency == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("missing declared source dependency: " + uri);
                dependencies[i][j] = dependency;
            }
            List<String> identity = new ArrayList<>(List.of("MINDEX_HIERARCHY_SOURCE_V1"));
            identity.addAll(file.address(repository).identityParts());
            identity.addAll(sourceParts(file.source));
            identity.add(Integer.toString(file.dependencies.size()));
            identity.addAll(file.dependencies);
            base[i] = M3FileSourceFacts.contextSha256(identity);
        }
        TreeMap<Address, Building> nodes = new TreeMap<>(ORDER);
        int[] seen = new int[files.length], queue = new int[files.length];
        long steps = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
            int generation = i + 1, length = 1;
            queue[0] = i; seen[i] = generation;
            for (int at = 0; at < length; at++) {
                if (++steps > limits.maxDependencySteps) throw new IllegalArgumentException("source dependency work budget");
                for (int dependency : dependencies[queue[at]]) {
                    if (++steps > limits.maxDependencySteps) throw new IllegalArgumentException("source dependency work budget");
                    if (seen[dependency] != generation) {
                        seen[dependency] = generation; queue[length++] = dependency;
                    }
                }
            }
            Arrays.sort(queue, 0, length);
            List<String> closure = new ArrayList<>(List.of("MINDEX_HIERARCHY_DEPENDENCY_CLOSURE_V1", providerSeal,
                    base[i], Integer.toString(length)));
            for (int j = 0; j < length; j++) closure.add(base[queue[j]]);
            Address leaf = files[i].address(repository);
            Building node = new Building(leaf);
            node.file = files[i]; node.leafSeal = M3FileSourceFacts.contextSha256(closure);
            nodes.put(leaf, node);
            for (Address child = leaf; child.level != Level.L5_REPOSITORY;) {
                Address parent = child.parent();
                nodes.computeIfAbsent(parent, Building::new).children.add(child);
                child = parent;
            }
            if (nodes.size() > limits.maxNodes) throw new IllegalArgumentException("hierarchy node budget");
        }
        Node[] result = new Node[nodes.size()];
        Map<Address, Integer> ordinals = new HashMap<>();
        int ordinal = 0, edgeCount = 0;
        for (Building node : nodes.values()) {
            ordinals.put(node.address, ordinal++);
            edgeCount = Math.addExact(edgeCount, node.children.size());
        }
        int[] offsets = new int[result.length + 1], childRows = new int[edgeCount];
        ordinal = 0; int edge = 0; long next = nextId;
        for (Building node : nodes.values()) {
            offsets[ordinal] = edge;
            List<String> identity = new ArrayList<>(List.of("MINDEX_HIERARCHY_NODE_V1", providerSeal));
            identity.addAll(node.address.identityParts());
            if (node.file != null) identity.add(node.leafSeal);
            identity.add(Integer.toString(node.children.size()));
            for (Address child : node.children) {
                int childOrdinal = ordinals.get(child);
                if (childOrdinal >= ordinal) throw new IllegalStateException("hierarchy child-before-parent invariant");
                childRows[edge++] = childOrdinal;
                identity.add(result[childOrdinal].identity);
            }
            String seal = M3FileSourceFacts.contextSha256(identity);
            Node prior = current == null ? null : current.find(node.address);
            long id;
            if (prior != null && prior.identity.equals(seal)) id = prior.id;
            else { id = next; next = Math.incrementExact(next); }
            String addressSeal = M3FileSourceFacts.contextSha256(node.address.identityParts());
            M3FileSourceFacts key = M3FileSourceFacts.capture("m3-hierarchy:" + addressSeal, seal,
                    contextSha256, providerId, schemaVersion, node.address.level.name());
            result[ordinal++] = new Node(node.address, node.file, seal, id, key);
        }
        offsets[result.length] = edge;
        Plan plan = new Plan(repository, result, ordinals, offsets, childRows);
        nextId = next; current = plan;
        return plan;
    }

    /** Immutable containment geometry; payloads remain solely in the existing swap cache. */
    public final class Plan {
        private final Address root;
        private final Node[] nodes;
        private final Map<Address, Integer> ordinals;
        private final int[] childOffsets, childOrdinals;
        private Plan(String repository, Node[] nodes, Map<Address, Integer> ordinals,
                int[] childOffsets, int[] childOrdinals) {
            root = new Address(Level.L5_REPOSITORY, repository, "", "", "", "");
            this.nodes = nodes; this.ordinals = Map.copyOf(ordinals);
            this.childOffsets = childOffsets; this.childOrdinals = childOrdinals;
        }
        public Address root() { return root; }
        public int nodeCount() { return nodes.length; }
        public int[] childOffsets() { return childOffsets.clone(); }
        public int[] childOrdinals() { return childOrdinals.clone(); }
        public List<Address> addresses(Level level) {
            Objects.requireNonNull(level, "level");
            List<Address> found = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Node node : nodes) if (node.address.level == level) found.add(node.address);
            return List.copyOf(found);
        }
        public long recordId(Address address) { return requireNode(address).id; }
        public String identitySha256(Address address) { return requireNode(address).identity; }
        /** Includes removed addresses as well as newly added or changed input closures. */
        public List<Address> changedFrom(Plan before) {
            Objects.requireNonNull(before, "before");
            if (before.owner() != MIndexASTHierarchy.this) throw new IllegalArgumentException("foreign hierarchy plan");
            TreeSet<Address> union = new TreeSet<>(ORDER);
            union.addAll(ordinals.keySet()); union.addAll(before.ordinals.keySet());
            union.removeIf(address -> {
                Node left = find(address), right = before.find(address);
                return left != null && right != null && left.identity.equals(right.identity);
            });
            return List.copyOf(union);
        }
        public M3ASTWorkspaceCache<MIndexASTHierarchyFacts>.Lease acquire(Address address,
                MIndexProgressMonitor monitor) throws IOException {
            synchronized (MIndexASTHierarchy.this) {
                requireOpen(); requireProvider();
                MIndexProgressMonitor actual = monitor == null ? MIndexProgressMonitor.none() : monitor;
                actual.checkCancelled();
                return acquireOrdinal(requireOrdinal(address), actual);
            }
        }
        public M3ASTWorkspaceCache<MIndexASTHierarchyFacts>.Lease acquire(Address address) throws IOException {
            return acquire(address, MIndexProgressMonitor.none());
        }
        private M3ASTWorkspaceCache<MIndexASTHierarchyFacts>.Lease acquireOrdinal(int ordinal,
                MIndexProgressMonitor monitor) throws IOException {
            Node node = nodes[ordinal];
            monitor.checkCancelled();
            var lease = cache.acquire(node.id, node.key, ignored -> compute(ordinal, monitor));
            try {
                MIndexASTHierarchyFacts facts = lease.value();
                if (facts.level() != node.address.level || !facts.identitySha256().equals(node.identity)
                        || !facts.contextSha256().equals(contextSha256) || !facts.providerId().equals(providerId)
                        || facts.schemaVersion() != schemaVersion || facts.valueCount() != fields.size())
                    throw new IOException("hierarchy payload identity mismatch");
                monitor.checkCancelled();
                return lease;
            } catch (IOException | RuntimeException | Error failure) { lease.close(); throw failure; }
        }
        private MIndexASTHierarchyFacts compute(int ordinal, MIndexProgressMonitor monitor) throws IOException {
            Node node = nodes[ordinal];
            long[] values;
            if (node.file != null) {
                MIndexPartialAstKey key = partialKey(node);
                MIndexPartialAstProjection projection = leaves.resolve(key,
                        (request, progress) -> new MIndexPartialAstAttempt.Success(project(node.file, request, progress)), monitor);
                monitor.checkCancelled(); requireProvider();
                values = provider.file(node.file, projection, monitor);
            } else {
                List<MIndexASTHierarchyFacts> children = new ArrayList<>(childOffsets[ordinal + 1] - childOffsets[ordinal]);
                for (int edge = childOffsets[ordinal]; edge < childOffsets[ordinal + 1]; edge++) {
                    try (var child = acquireOrdinal(childOrdinals[edge], monitor)) { children.add(child.value()); }
                }
                monitor.checkCancelled(); requireProvider();
                values = provider.aggregate(node.address.level, List.copyOf(children), monitor);
            }
            monitor.checkCancelled(); requireProvider();
            if (values == null || values.length != fields.size()) throw new IllegalStateException("provider fact arity drift");
            return new MIndexASTHierarchyFacts(node.address.level, node.identity, contextSha256,
                    providerId, schemaVersion, values);
        }
        private int requireOrdinal(Address address) {
            Integer ordinal = ordinals.get(Objects.requireNonNull(address, "address"));
            if (ordinal == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("address outside hierarchy plan");
            return ordinal;
        }
        private Node requireNode(Address address) { return nodes[requireOrdinal(address)]; }
        private Node find(Address address) {
            Integer ordinal = ordinals.get(address);
            return ordinal == null ? null : nodes[ordinal];
        }
        private MIndexASTHierarchy owner() { return MIndexASTHierarchy.this; }
    }

    private record Node(Address address, FileInput file, String identity, long id, M3FileSourceFacts key) { }
    private static final class Building {
        private final Address address;
        private final TreeSet<Address> children = new TreeSet<>(ORDER);
        private FileInput file;
        private String leafSeal;
        private Building(Address address) { this.address = address; }
    }

    private MIndexPartialAstKey partialKey(Node node) {
        // Full context and closure are part of the parser profile because the existing SYNTAX
        // key intentionally omits its semantic environment field. Parser scopes remain unchanged.
        String profile = M3FileSourceFacts.contextSha256(List.of("MINDEX_HIERARCHY_PARTIAL_V1", providerSeal, node.identity));
        return new MIndexPartialAstKey(node.file.source.sourceSha256(), profile, "", 0,
                0, 2L * node.file.source.utf16Length(), 0, node.file.source.utf16Length(),
                MIndexPartialAstScope.FILE, MIndexPartialAstMode.SYNTAX, limits.ast);
    }

    private MIndexPartialAstProjection project(FileInput input, MIndexPartialAstKey key,
            MIndexProgressMonitor monitor) {
        monitor.checkCancelled();
        MIndexASTDocument document = Objects.requireNonNull(input.document.get(), "frozen document");
        if (!document.sourceName().equals(input.source.sourceUri())
                || document.source().length() != input.source.utf16Length()
                || !M3FileSourceFacts.sourceSha256(document.source()).equals(input.source.sourceSha256())
                || !rawUtf16Sha256(document.source()).equals(document.sourceUtf16Sha256()))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("frozen hierarchy source identity mismatch");
        MIndexAST root = document.root();
        MIndexASTSnapshot snapshot = root.snapshot();
        if (snapshot.size() > limits.ast.nodes() || root.depth() > limits.ast.depth()
                || document.occurrences().size() > limits.ast.tokens())
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("hierarchy AST admission budget");
        long edges = 0, attributes = 0, symbolChars = 0;
        HashSet<String> symbols = new HashSet<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < snapshot.size(); i++) {
            if ((i & 255) == 0) monitor.checkCancelled();
            MIndexAST atom = snapshot.ref(i);
            edges = Math.addExact(edges, atom.childCount());
            attributes = Math.addExact(attributes, atom.attributeCount());
            List<String> strings = new ArrayList<>(1 + atom.attributeCount() * 2 + atom.childCount());
            strings.add(atom.kind().toString());
            for (int j = 0; j < atom.attributeCount(); j++) {
                strings.add(atom.attributeName(j).toString()); strings.add(atom.attributeValue(j).toString());
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < atom.childCount(); j++) strings.add(atom.childRole(j).toString());
            for (String symbol : strings) if (symbols.add(symbol)) symbolChars = Math.addExact(symbolChars, symbol.length());
            if (edges > limits.ast.edges() || attributes > limits.ast.attributes()
                    || symbols.size() > limits.ast.symbols() || symbolChars > limits.ast.symbolChars())
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("hierarchy AST geometry budget");
        }
        // The document's occurrence handles must belong to this exact original atom owner.
        MIndexAST[] reachable = new MIndexAST[snapshot.size()];
        int[] pending = new int[snapshot.size()]; int count = 1;
        reachable[root.contentIndex()] = root; pending[0] = root.contentIndex();
        for (int at = 0; at < count; at++) {
            if ((at & 255) == 0) monitor.checkCancelled();
            MIndexAST atom = reachable[pending[at]];
            for (int child = 0; child < atom.childCount(); child++) {
                MIndexAST next = atom.child(child); int id = next.contentIndex();
                if (reachable[id] == null) { reachable[id] = next; pending[count++] = id; }
            }
        }
        for (MIndexASTOccurrence occurrence : document.occurrences()) {
            int id = occurrence.atom().contentIndex();
            if (id < 0 || id >= reachable.length || !occurrence.atom().equals(reachable[id]))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("foreign hierarchy occurrence atom");
        }
        long retained = Math.addExact(128L + 32L * snapshot.size(),
                Math.addExact(8L * (edges + attributes), 2L * symbolChars));
        monitor.checkCancelled();
        return new MIndexPartialAstProjection(key, snapshot, root.contentIndex(), retained, 0);
    }

    private static List<String> sourceParts(M3FileSourceFacts source) {
        return List.of(source.sourceUri(), source.sourceSha256(), Integer.toString(source.utf16Length()),
                source.contextSha256(), source.providerId(), Integer.toString(source.schemaVersion()), source.phase());
    }
    private static String rawUtf16Sha256(String source) {
        try {
            MessageDigest digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
            for (int i = 0; i < source.length(); i++) {
                char c = source.charAt(i); digest.update((byte) (c >>> 8)); digest.update((byte) c);
            }
            return HexFormat.of().formatHex(digest.digest());
        } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException impossible) { throw new AssertionError(impossible); }
    }
    private static String token(String value, boolean empty) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(value, "hierarchy name");
        if ((!empty && value.isBlank()) || value.indexOf('\0') >= 0 || value.length() > 16_384)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("hierarchy name");
        return value;
    }
    private void requireName(String value) {
        if (value.length() > limits.maxNameChars) throw new IllegalArgumentException("hierarchy name budget");
    }
    private void requireProvider() {
        if (!providerId.equals(provider.id()) || schemaVersion != provider.schemaVersion() || !fields.equals(provider.fields()))
            throw new IllegalStateException("hierarchy provider identity/schema drift");
    }
    private void requireOpen() { if (closed) throw new IllegalStateException("closed hierarchy"); }
    @Override public synchronized void close() throws IOException {
        if (closed) return;
        if (ownsCache) cache.close();
        current = null; closed = true;
    }
}
